title: Essential function of adaptor protein Nck1 in platelet-derived growth factor receptor signaling in human lens epithelial cells.
authors: Paensuwan, Pussadee; Ngoenkam, Jatuporn; Wangteeraprasert, Apirath; Pongcharoen, Sutatip
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Nck1衔接蛋白在PDGFR信号通路中对晶状体上皮细胞增殖迁移的调控，属于细胞信号转导与疾病机制研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Binding of platelet-derived growth factor-BB (PDGF-BB) to its cognate receptor (PDGFR) promotes lens epithelial cell (LEC) proliferation and migration. After cataract surgery, these LEC behaviors have been proposed as an influential cause of posterior capsule opacification (PCO). Stimulated PDFGR undergoes dimerization and tyrosine phosphorylation providing docking sites for a SH2-domain-containing noncatalytic region of tyrosine kinase (Nck). Nck is an adaptor protein acting as a linker of the proximal and downstream signaling events. However, the functions of Nck1 protein in LEC have not been investigated so far. We reported here a crucial role of Nck1 protein in regulating PDGFR-mediated LEC activation using LEC with a silenced expression of Nck1 protein. The knockdown of Nck1 suppressed PDGF-BB-stimulated LEC proliferation and migration and disrupted the cell cycle progression especially G1/S transition. LEC lacking Nck1 protein failed to exhibit actin polymerization and membrane protrusions. The downregulation of Nck1 protein in LEC impaired PDGFR-induced phosphorylation of intracellular signaling proteins, including Erk1/2, Akt, CREB and ATF1, which resulted in inhibition of LEC responses. Therefore, these data suggest that the loss of Nck1 expression may disturb LEC activation and Nck1 may potentially be a drug target to prevent PCO and lens-related disease.
abstract_zh: 血小板衍生生长因子-BB（PDGF-BB）与其同源受体（PDGFR）的结合促进晶状体上皮细胞（LEC）的增殖和迁移。在白内障手术后，这些LEC行为已被提出作为后发性白内障（PCO）的一个影响因素。受刺激的PDGFR经历二聚化和酪氨酸磷酸化，为含有SH2结构域的酪氨酸激酶非催化区（Nck）提供对接位点。Nck是一种衔接蛋白，作为近端和下游信号事件的连接器。然而，Nck1蛋白在LEC中的功能迄今尚未被研究。我们在此报道了Nck1蛋白在调节PDGFR介导的LEC激活中的关键作用，使用Nck1蛋白沉默表达的LEC。Nck1的敲低抑制了PDGF-BB刺激的LEC增殖和迁移，并破坏了细胞周期进程，尤其是G1/S转换。缺乏Nck1蛋白的LEC未能表现出肌动蛋白聚合和膜突起。LEC中Nck1蛋白的下调损害了PDGFR诱导的细胞内信号蛋白磷酸化，包括Erk1/2、Akt、CREB和ATF1，从而导致LEC反应受到抑制。因此，这些数据表明，Nck1表达的缺失可能干扰LEC激活，且Nck1可能成为预防PCO和晶状体相关疾病的潜在药物靶点。
